composition: Mg, commercially pure / high-purity forms vary by specification
corrosion: Reactive; galvanic coupling and aqueous corrosion require careful control.
manufacturing: Cast, wrought and machined forms exist; exact process route materially affects properties.
machinability: Generally excellent cutting behaviour, but chip ignition/fire risk must be controlled.
provenance_requirement: Verify against exact grade, product form, temper/condition, specification and primary/manufacturer source before design use.

composition: Mg-Al-Zn wrought alloy; exact limits depend on applicable specification/product form
corrosion: Requires corrosion protection in many aqueous/galvanic environments.
manufacturing: Sheet, plate, bar, extrusion and other wrought products; texture and processing condition affect anisotropy.
availability: good for established magnesium supply chains
provenance_requirement: Verify against exact grade, product form, temper/condition, specification and primary/manufacturer source before design use.

composition: Mg-Al-Zn cast alloy; specification controls exact composition and product requirements
corrosion: Corrosion behaviour is strongly condition/environment dependent; coatings and isolation may be required.
manufacturing: High-pressure die casting and related casting routes; porosity and microstructure are important.
provenance_requirement: Verify against exact grade, product form, temper/condition, specification and primary/manufacturer source before design use.

composition: Mg-Y-rare-earth-Zr family; exact chemistry depends on specification and product form
corrosion: Better high-temperature capability than common Mg-Al alloys, but corrosion protection remains application dependent.
manufacturing: Cast and wrought variants; heat treatment and ageing are important to final properties.
provenance_requirement: Verify against exact grade, product form, temper/condition, specification and primary/manufacturer source before design use.

composition: Mg-Zn-Zr wrought alloy; exact chemistry and temper depend on specification
corrosion: Requires environment-specific assessment and galvanic isolation where applicable.
manufacturing: Extrusion/forging and other wrought routes; texture and temper materially affect performance.
machinability: good to excellent with appropriate controls
provenance_requirement: Verify against exact grade, product form, temper/condition, specification and primary/manufacturer source before design use.
